messages:
Maya: heads up—deploy-bot blocked the staging promote. CI artifact verify failed after a cache TTL regen spike. checksum mismatch on S3 multipart object. we need a quick call: pin, reupload, or rollback?
Raj: can you paste the failed verify lines?
Taylor: log from `integration-artifact-verify`:
```
ERROR: artifact verification failed
s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/commit-0f9c8a2.tar.gz checksum mismatch (expected 7f3b..., got 2a9d...)
Cause: multipart upload incomplete / truncated object
```
Taylor: note: same commit verified fine in a few earlier canaries and locally. looks like the object got corrupted during a concurrent restore/ttl regen.
Sam: ugh—the cache-ttl-regen cascade. If we reupload it might take 20-30m for integrity + propagation. Release window closes in ~45m.
Maya: options: 1) pin to last-good artifact sha (fast), 2) reupload commit artifact and wait (risk missing window), 3) hold and rollback the promotion (safe but delays release).
Raj: what's last-good sha?
Taylor: last-good is sha256:3b7e1f9. Canary used it 2h ago with no issues.
Sam: promote last-good and force bypass auto-verify? deploy-bot will just re-run the same verify job unless we tell it to force.
Maya: @deploy-bot any CLI for manual promote-by-sha?
deploy-bot: automated message: promotion failed for release 2026-03-22T10:00UTC. Manual promote available. See `deploybot help promote`.
Raj: manual promote command:
```
# promote a specific artifact to staging
deploybot promote --env=staging --artifact-sha=sha256:3b7e1f9 --force --reason="temp pin due to CI artifact mismatch"
```
Sam: note: `--force` skips automated artifact verification. We should do a small canary (10%) for 30m and monitor.
Taylor: I'll open a follow-up INFRA ticket to reupload commit-0f9c8a2 and validate checksums. We shouldn't leave a corrupted object in the registry.
Maya: agreed. Sam—can you run the promote? Also create a release-note blurb mentioning the temporary pin.
Sam: running the promote now.
Sam: executed `deploybot promote` with force and canary 10%. deploy-bot: promotion queued -> canary -> staging.
Maya: release notes: "Temporary pin to sha256:3b7e1f9 due to CI artifact verification mismatch; follow-up ticket INFRA-1229 opened to reupload and validate commit-0f9c8a2."
Raj: add a note in the release Slack thread and to the release checklist so PMs are aware.
Taylor: INFRA-1229 created and assigned to storage-team, ETA 2h. Steps: reupload artifact, run `sha256sum`, verify multipart reassembly, and purge truncated object.
Maya: decision: manual pin to last-good (sha256:3b7e1f9), canary 10% for 30m, follow-up ticket INFRA-1229. If canary shows errors, rollback immediately.
Sam: monitoring hooks set; alerts to #eng-oncall and #product-release. I'll create a short alert escalation runbook note in the ticket.
Taylor: runbook checklist I left in the ticket:
- confirm canary health metrics (error rate, latency) for 30m
- if errors exceed threshold -> rollback to previous stable (automated)
- after reupload, validate checksums and re-trigger CI verify job
- mark release notes & release checklist with pin reason
Maya: thanks—I'll update release docs and close the loop when INFRA-1229 completes. :thumbsup:
